question: India is bounded by the Hindukush mountain range in the _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**north-west**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **​Hindukus**
 
• 
 
 
• ​The main mountain ranges of India do not include the Hindu Kush range.​
 
• The Hindu Kush is a mountain range that is 800 kilometers long and stretches through Afghanistan, Northern Pakistan, and Tajikistan.
 
• Mount Tirich Mir located in the Chitral District of Pakistan is the highest mountain of the Hindu Kush range.
